items.exemplar:
A. Trump promised a wall along the Mexican border to curb illegal immigration — his signature 2016 pledge.

B. He promised to cut taxes, repeal Obamacare, withdraw from the Iran deal, renegotiate NAFTA, and move the U.S. embassy in Israel to Jerusalem.

C. He could not fulfill the promise to repeal and replace the Affordable Care Act: the 2017 Senate repeal effort failed by one vote.
parts: A. Briefly explain ONE political promise Donald Trump made to his supporters.
B. Briefly explain a SECOND such promise.
C. Briefly explain ONE Trump promise he was unable to fulfill.
items.stimulus: Political scientists describe Trump's 2016 campaign as promise-driven populism — a candidate who bound supporters to him through vivid, specific pledges ('build the wall,' 'repeal and replace') that became tests of loyalty.
